violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: Observed eggs store on service cart next to wok at room temperature, cooked chicken, raw chicken, bean sprouts in unit # 1 at 43, 44, 58F, green curry, red curry, red curry ( lower cooler) in unit # 3at 44, 44, 44F
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less.CFM relocated egg to the WIR, CFM discarded cooked chicken, raw chicken, bean sprouts from unit # 1, green curry, red curry, red curry ( lower cooler) from unit # 3

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method:Observed raw shrimp thawing in the 3-compartment sink in standing water
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CFM completely submerged the raw shrimp under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. Observed no food thermometer during the inspection
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.CFM will attain a food thermometer

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Observed seasoning container and squeeze bottles with no name.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will labels all seasoning container and squeeze bottles. PASARA THAI (Inspection Date: 10/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed oil store directly on the floor in dry storage
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM will attain dunnage racks and elevate the oil ( clear liquid)

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet clean towels store in counters
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.CFM prepare a sanitizer bucket and store wiping clothes in sanitizer bucket.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed drunken noodles, Bean sprouts in unit # 1 at 55, 67F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded drunken noodles, Bean sprouts

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Observed red, green and yellow curry without a preparation or expiration date
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM marked all curries.

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed open drinking container in the preparation table.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CFM discard drink

violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CFM covered all curries.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Knives store in the crack between cooler and service table.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM washed, rinsed, sanitized knives and store inside the cooler on a food container.
